reference_note: No independent benchmark. Pairwise cast votes are compared before consensus selection and stratified by tangtv_tier. The paper population is upper-shelf Prad/TangTV only; lower-shelf votes are provisional. Agreement does not establish physical state accuracy.

bootstrap.unit: shot with at least one compared vote pair
bootstrap.ci: percentile 95%; undefined draws excluded and counted

pairwise_agreement.schema_note: all_eligible_bins and fit_bins_train_val_outside now nest tangtv_tier then indicator pair. No cross-tier agreement rollup is emitted. by_tangtv_tier and fit_by_tangtv_tier are named aliases.
